items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He taught me the waltz, and he taught me the scales... Isadore Fritz(?) would come around and give me a few lessons for free.

ctx.x: Let me ask you this before we forget it. Manuel Roque... You said there was a couple of guys who taught you. Who was the other guy?
I had another guy named Isadore Fritz(?). They were good...
